newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish June retail sales value unchanged m/m.
newsitem.headline: Irish June retail sales value unchanged m/m.

text.p: The value of Irish retail sales for June was unchanged on the previous month, giving a year-on-year increase of 12.2 percent, Central Statistics Office (CSO) data showed on Friday.

In May, the value of sales was also unchanged over the month and up 10.4 percent year on year, the CSO said. This was revised from provisional estimates of a 0.4 percent monthly rise and a 10.9 percent annual rise.
Sales volume in May was up 0.2 percent on April and was 8.5 percent higher than in May last year.
